proposedContracts.scope: md5/hash/crc/streamhash default algorithms over 20 PCM codecs, 1/2/6 channels, 8000/44100 Hz, 0/1/4097 samples; byte-identical output files. No -hash, no video.

proposedContracts.scope: Hash muxer output after -af volume=0.5 (-cpuflags 0), output -t/-frames:a, WAV and raw -c copy; byte-identical output files.

proposedContracts.name: refuses -hash before any output exists while native accepts murmur3 and sha256
proposedContracts.scope: -hash is refused explicitly with no output file; native acceptance recorded.

notes: Setup durations: submodule init 36 s, npm ci 8 s, reference:build 141 s, typecheck+lint+boundaries 46 s, unit baseline 66 s; differential file 44 s.

Baseline and final unit runs are identical: 13 failed tests in 6 files (FLAC wasm/native fixtures unavailable because downloads.xiph.org is blocked; resample-checkpoint macOS arm64 goldens), 2261 passed after the change (2253 before + 8 new).
Supporting -hash needs one entry in packages/cli/src/index.ts's values set (a shared edit not allowed in wave 1). digests.ts already implements md5, sha160, sha224, sha256, crc32 and adler32 for it.
Side effect by registry design: containerOutputListing (and the generic 'Output requires ...' refusal) now lists crc, hash, md5, streamhash after framecrc.
Native crc with -hash exits 0 (option unused by crc), recorded in the refusal test.
